title: Review a harness artifact
summary: Reviews one exact drafted harness change for ownership, contract shape, behavior evidence, privacy, authority, and claim boundaries before adoption.

intent.goal: Produce an unreviewed pre-verdict disposition when the exact basis is unavailable; otherwise produce an evidence-grounded adopt, revise, or reject recommendation.
useWhen: One drafted governed artifact or change set is ready for independent review.
excludeWhen: The artifact still needs initial authoring, promotion after real use, or an unrelated repository-wide audit.

procedure.outcome: Bind review to one exact draft tree, target responsibility, and claimed behavior, or return the draft unreviewed when that exact basis is unavailable.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Return the unreviewed pre-verdict disposition and stop when the exact draft basis or required mechanical floor is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Check canonical path, owner, layer direction, dependencies, privacy, and authority declarations.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Compare claimed outcomes to exact scenarios, adversarial cases, and current verifier coverage.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Rank actionable correctness, security, compatibility, upgrade, and claim-boundary findings with exact evidence.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

procedure.outcome: Return unreviewed when the exact draft or required mechanical floor is unavailable. Only for an exact bound draft and evidence set return adopt, revise, or reject; use revise only for evidenced candidate changes, never missing review inputs.
requirements: Bind every input and observation to one exact governed source or explicit operator decision.
stopConditions: Stop when required evidence, authority, or an exact prerequisite is unavailable.

safeguards: Never substitute checker success or author testimony for behavior evidence.
Never rubber-stamp a draft with unresolved correctness or authority findings.
Never label an unavailable or unbound review basis adopt, revise, or reject; return it unreviewed with the missing basis instead.
Never merge, publish, install, or realize a reviewed draft merely because review completed.
limitations: This definition declares workflow outcomes and boundaries; it does not itself grant execution, provider, publication, merge, or host-realization authority.
Behavior evidence and effects remain scoped to exact governed development requests and current workflow fingerprints.
